name: ippo_p_supplementary_s3_prior_scale_probe
registration: internal, author-controlled, hash-locked; not externally registered
role: post-confirmation supplementary sensitivity probe; never merged into the frozen confirmatory test
question: Is the frozen prior scale 2.25 a knife-edge choice, or is the effect direction stable across nearby scales?

design.scale_selection_rationale: locked before any run; 2.25 sits between 1.5 and 3.0, 1.0 doubles as the no-prior-adjacent anchor; symmetric around the frozen value
design.method: IPPO-P with action_prior_scale varied; everything else identical to the confirmatory protocol

decision_rule_primary: descriptive: report per-scale mean U and direction versus archived H1 IPPO mean; n=2 per scale cannot confirm any direction

all_directions_stable.condition: all three scales show direction consistent with the confirmatory H1 effect
all_directions_stable.conclusion_writing: report the frozen scale is not a knife-edge within the probed range, with the n=2 caveat

direction_unstable.conclusion_writing: report honestly that effect direction at H1 is scale-sensitive in the probed range; add to limitations; do not hide the reversed scale

mixed_or_weak.conclusion_writing: report the observed pattern as descriptive

anti_goals: no additional scales added after seeing results
no re-labelling of a reversed scale as an anomaly without evidence
results never merged into the confirmatory test
